reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: param = request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to response.getWriter().println(param) at line 22. While param.matches(pat) validates against a deploy-time regex, regex-based validation is not equivalent to proper HTML encoding/sanitization. Attacker-controlled input reaching the HTML output sink constitutes a real XSS vulnerability. Resolved sink value: param (potentially attacker-controlled user input).

evidence.note: User input from request.getParameter flows directly to response.getWriter().println without HTML encoding
